$comment: CGCI campus dataset transcribed from the official 'Core Gateway College, Inc. Campus Site Map' (1920 x 1120 source). Vertex coordinates are that drawing projected onto the 1000 x 620 schematic canvas, preserving relative position and scale.

meta.source: Core Gateway College, Inc. Campus Site Map (official, 1920 x 1120)
meta.provenance: Building names, footprints, floor assignments and open areas transcribed from the official campus site map. Walkway distances are surveyed estimates in metres, not taken from the drawing, which carries no scale.
meta.notice: Six of the sixteen locations are still labelled "BLDG. NAME" on the official site map and have not been named by the college. They are named here by their documented contents so they can be routed to, and are flagged verified:false.
notes: The site plan legend lists 'Buildings (Academic)' twice with different colours, so colour alone cannot separate the building types. Categories here are assigned by the functions the plan documents inside each building: CORE 5 is administrative because it lists Admin, HR and Finance.

The CORE 1 to North Wing path is stored closed. This is a demonstration of how reopening a path changes the shortest route, not a real closure on campus. Open it from Admin -> Paths to watch Dijkstra re-route.
Five points on the plan are marked 'PARKING AREA', 'SCHOOL GROUND', 'SHS SCHOOL GROUND' or a dashed court area. They are treated as navigable open areas and become vertices.

Walkway distances are estimates. The drawing has no scale bar, so distances were derived from the projection and rounded to plausible walking lengths. An administrator can correct any value from Admin -> Paths.
